shortDescription: NetApp E-Series Web Services Proxy manage storage arrays

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity WebServices Proxy or embedded REST API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity WebServices Proxy or embedded REST API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity WebServices Proxy or embedded REST API.

options.name: array_password
options.description: The management password of the array to manage, if set.

options.name: array_status_timeout_sec
options.description: Array status timeout measured in seconds

options.name: array_wwn
options.description: The WWN of the array to manage. Only necessary if in-band managing multiple arrays on the same agent host.  Mutually exclusive of controller_addresses parameter.

options.name: controller_addresses
options.description: The list addresses for the out-of-band management adapter or the agent host. Mutually exclusive of array_wwn parameter.

options.name: enable_trace
options.description: Enable trace logging for SYMbol calls to the storage system.

options.name: meta_tags
options.description: Optional meta tags to associate to this storage system

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified array should be configured on the Web Services Proxy or not.
